note: 话题优先：中文的话题句被直译成英文，执行者没进主语位
original: We'll ship this feature next week.
glossZh: 这个功能我们下周上线。
attempt: This feature we will do next week.

note: 意合 → 形合：中文逗号串句直译成英文逗号粘连病句
original: It's freezing, so I'm not going out.
attempt: It's very cold, I don't want to go out.

note: 连动句：中文一串动词直译，英文一句只能有一个主动词
original: I grabbed a coffee on my way back.
glossZh: 我去买了个咖啡回来喝。
attempt: I go buy a coffee come back drink.

note: 冠词漏用 —— 中文没有冠词这个语法范畴
original: The bug was in the code I wrote to find the bug.
glossZh: 结果那个 bug 就在我为了找 bug 而写的代码里。
attempt: Bug was in code I wrote to find bug.

note: 时态：中文没有形态标记，讲过去的事却用现在时
original: I spent four hours on a problem that a five minute conversation would have solved.
glossZh: 我在一个问题上耗了四个小时，而这个问题聊五分钟就能解决。
attempt: I spend four hours on a problem that a five minutes talk can solve.

note: 单复数 + 可数不可数：less/fewer，thing/things
original: It's about having fewer things to decide.
glossZh: 关键在于需要做的决定更少。
attempt: It is about have less thing to decide.

note: 介词搭配 —— 中文母语者的终身漏点之一
original: I'm really interested in how people learn.
glossZh: 我对人是怎么学东西的这件事特别感兴趣。
attempt: I am very interested about how people study.

note: 词块：中文的「是」表示「关键在于」时不能直译成 is
original: Writing things down isn't about remembering them. It's about finding out whether they make sense.
glossZh: 把事情写下来不是为了记住，是为了搞清楚它到底讲不讲得通。
attempt: Write down things is not for remember. It is for know if it is reasonable.

note: 语气：原文用 most of 限定，学习者说死了
original: Most of my best decisions looked boring at the time.
glossZh: 我那些最好的决定，当时看着都挺没意思的。
attempt: All my best decisions are boring at that time.

note: ★ 最关键的测试：学习者写法不同但同样地道。引擎必须敢给 equal，且不得判 wrong
original: I'll take a boring codebase over a clever one any day.
glossZh: 让我选的话，我永远选无聊的代码库，不选炫技的。
attempt: Given the choice, I'd always pick a boring codebase over a clever one.

note: ★ 学习者几乎完全写对。引擎不许为了凑数量硬造错误
original: Most of my best decisions looked boring at the time.
glossZh: 我那些最好的决定，当时看着都挺没意思的。
attempt: Most of my best decisions seemed boring at the time.

original: Reading code is a skill. We just never practice it on purpose.
glossZh: 读代码是一项技能，我们只是从来没有刻意练过。
attempt: Read code are a skill. We just never practice them purposely.
